_comment: DECLARED STATE of the live Ghost pages this repo did not produce. Written 2026-09-19 under backlog I167,
Brad's ruling option 1 (ADOPT), in the shape ops\cloudflare-estate.json uses for the Cloudflare estate.
WHY THESE EXIST. On 2026-09-18 a read-only census of every post and page Ghost holds found 1,089 live objects
(published or sent) and 202 whose slug no tracked file names as a whole token. Five are email-only price alerts
(see email_only below). The other 197 are PUBLIC web pages: 196 posts published 2026-07-04 and 2026-07-05
(money how-tos, calculators, a glossary, meal-prep guides) and the refunds page. The item text said 195 posts:
its loose test counted debt-payoff-calculator as named, because the letters appear inside the WORKBOOK file name
Simple-Money-Playbook-Debt-Payoff-Calculator.xlsx in site\build\build-debt-calculator.ps1, which builds a
spreadsheet and never that post. The strict whole-token test the census uses does not count it, so it is here.
WHAT A DECLARATION MEANS. The page is live, public, and owned by the estate although no script produces it. Its
body and metadata were exported with read-only Admin API GETs into export_dir, so its numbers can be read and
checked. Nothing a reader sees changed when this file was written.
ops\audit-ghost-page-census.ps1 reads this file every day and fails when: a live page is neither produced by a
tracked source nor declared here; a declared page is no longer live; a declared page's visibility differs from
the visibility recorded here (the paywall direction: public here, paid live, or the reverse, is a finding either
way); or a declared page was edited in Ghost after its export, so the adopted copy is stale. Re-export with
ops\audit-ghost-page-census.ps1 -Export after reading what changed.
THE EXPORT COMMIT is the commit that added export_dir: git log --diff-filter=A --format=%h -- content/ghost-adopted.
It is not written here because the push rebases and renames it; exported_from_base is the origin/main commit the
export was taken on.

email_only.rule: A post whose Ghost status is sent is an email that was never published to the web (the public URL of one was read on 2026-09-19 and answered 404). It is counted and listed by the census, never failed and never adopted, because there is no page for a reader to land on.
